detail.meaning: PASS = each picked look is the designator's style and lands on the blueprint (build) or building (god)
PASS = blueprint -> frame -> building kept each look; each reel prints its look's STORED art and selects its look's hose set
PASS = each laid reel prints its look's EMPTY DRUM and its hose draws that look's pieces, including >= 3 reels whose look is not the global default

rows.detail: run with --save NAME to include save/load

detail.meaning: PASS = reeling in restores each look's STORED art and keeps the stored style
PASS = an unstyled reel stores NO style (an older save is unchanged) yet draws, and lays its hose in, the default look
